mapper.select: select activity_id, activity_name, discount_expr, group_type, take_limit_count, target, valid_time, status, start_time, end_time, tag_id, tag_scope, opening_enabled from activity where activity_id = #{activityId} and status = 1
select opening_enabled, start_time, end_time from activity where activity_id = #{activityId} and status = 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into activity (activity_id, activity_name, discount_expr, group_type, take_limit_count, target, valid_time, status, start_time, end_time, tag_id, tag_scope, opening_enabled, create_time, update_time) values (#{activityId}, #{activityName}, '', 1, #{takeLimitCount}, #{target}, #{validTime}, 1, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, '', '', 1, now(), now())
mapper.update: update activity set opening_enabled = 0, update_time = now() where activity_id = #{activityId} and status = 1 and opening_enabled = 1
